headline: On last trading day, Sensex surged over 1,500 points as IT stocks led a broad-based market rally

marketStatus.message: Market is closed today because it is a weekend. It will reopen on Monday, 19 October.

why: IT stocks led strong gains across Dalal Street during the last session.
Strengthening of the Indian rupee boosted investor confidence.
Markets rallied despite global sell-off pressures, pushing Nifty towards 23,000.
Bulls returned to the market as Sensex jumped over 1,500 points in a massive surge.
whatHappening: Reliance's Jio Platforms filed its final IPO prospectus with the offer opening on October 21.
Bank of Baroda shares dropped 3.5% following a $15 billion lawsuit by NMC founder BR Shetty.
Hyundai announced an additional ₹4,000 crore investment in its Pune plant to boost output.
Zydus received 5 observations from the U.S. FDA for its manufacturing facility.
summary: On the last trading day, Indian benchmark indices witnessed a massive rally with Sensex surging over 1,500 points, propelled by IT sector gains and a stronger rupee. Key corporate headlines include Reliance's Jio Platforms finalizing its IPO prospectus and Hyundai expanding its Pune manufacturing capacity. Meanwhile, Bank of Baroda faced pressure after being sued for $15 billion by NMC's founder.
